Jenna Park: Hey folks — I submitted my two-week notice today. Last day will be Fri Aug 2. I want to make sure we coordinate: COBRA timing, benefits end date, final paycheck, laptop return/shipping, oncall handoff, and prorated stipends. CC @People Ops :wave:
People Ops: Thanks for the heads up, Jenna. We'll start the checklist. Quick answers up front: benefits coverage and perks, COBRA window, payroll timing, and laptop return. We'll follow up with exact dates and links. Can you confirm your preferred shipping address for hardware?
Jenna Park: Yep — 123 Maple St, Apt 5, SF 94107. Also want to confirm whether the last monthly commuter stipend is prorated or if it stops immediately.
People Ops: Commuter/parking stipends are prorated to your last active payroll period. Ben from payroll will confirm exact amount once we know the last pay date.
Ben (Payroll): Hi — payroll cutoff for Aug payroll is Jul 28. If your last day is Aug 2, final pay run will include prorated salary and any eligible stipends through Aug 2, processed on the Aug 15 payroll (usual schedule). If you have outstanding expense reports, file them by Jul 30 to be included.
Mike - IT: Jenna — we can ship a prepaid return label. Please: 1) backup any personal files, 2) remove personal MFA devices from SSO, 3) put the laptop back in original box if possible. I'll create a manifest and email the label. Device will be wiped upon receipt.
Jenna Park: Thx. Any specific SSO groups I should leave? I use oncall and eng-general.
Mike - IT: Leave everything as-is until deprovision window. We'll remove access on your last business day 2024-08-02 11:59pm PT. Please transfer any critical tokens. For PagerDuty: export your escalation policy membership and share the runbook link.
Kyle L.: Jenna — I'll take over your oncall shifts. Can you add me +@people-ops to your runbook and shadow the Fri night rotation once? Also drop any ongoing PRs/pending releases in the handoff doc (link: https://redwood-internal/docs/runbooks/jpark-handoff).
Jenna Park: Will do. I'll add a short checklist in the runbook tonight with commands and common incidents.
People Ops: COBRA/benefits notes: medical/dental/vision coverage generally continues through the last day of the month containing your termination date (so coverage through 2024-08-31 if last day is Aug 2). We send COBRA election packet via email within ~14 days; you then have up to 60 days to elect. For specifics, use the COBRA portal: https://redwood-internal/hr/cobra (or we can email PDF).
Jenna Park: Is my equity cliff/vesting affected? I have a small RSU grant that vests every quarter — will I get anything prorated?
People Ops: Standard equity rules apply per the grant agreement. Typically, unvested RSUs do not accelerate on resignation. We'll route your grant questions to Comp/People Ops to confirm exact vesting schedule.
Ben (Payroll): For final paycheck details and any prorated stipend numbers, DM me and I can run a quick calc. Also note: final pay will include accrued PTO payout according to policy.
People Ops: Action items checklist: 1) Jenna confirm shipping address (done). 2) Jenna add runbook + PR list (Jenna). 3) Mike to create return label + deprovision plan (Mike). 4) Ben to calculate final pay + stipend proration (Ben). 5) People Ops to schedule exit interview and send COBRA packet (People Ops). 6) Manager to confirm oncall reassignment (Kyle).
Mike - IT: Draft of deprovision schedule (tentative): 
```
2024-08-02 09:00am PT - disable new device registrations
2024-08-02 12:00pm PT - remove SSO group memberships
2024-08-02 11:59pm PT - full account disable (email access removed)
```
People Ops: We'll hold off final disable until you confirm handoff complete. We'll also set up a short exit survey + 30-min exit interview; options Weds or Thurs next week — ping me which you prefer.
Jenna Park: Wed afternoon works best. Thanks everyone — appreciate the clear plan. :heart:
Kyle L.: Thanks, Jenna — will coordinate the shadow. :+1:
Mike - IT: Label emailed, ETA pickup Fri morning. Marking ticket #IT-4543.
People Ops: Closing notes: please expect COBRA packet by email from benefits@payroll within two weeks. If you want us to transfer any learning artifacts to the public handbook, ping me the links.
Jenna Park: Got it. I'll post the runbook and finish PRs by Tue EOD.
